default.$description: Component borders and dividers: inputs, tables, cards and rules, and the resting outline on form fields. The width for any border with no reason to be heavier.

focused.$description: The ring drawn around a focused element: form fields, the file input, checkboxes and radios (form.scss), the accordion (accordion.scss) and the circle button, which moved from 3px on 2026-09-28 (button.scss). Four places draw focus differently, each noted in its CSS: the toggle (form.scss) and the accordion label (accordion.scss) use a 1px outline with a background change; the circle button draws its ring as a border on a pseudo-element (button.scss); and buttons show an underline and a growing accent bar (_utilities.scss).
